text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —My Lord. Yaeno has arrived before you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ohh, Yaeno! Draw closer, draw closer♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Um, excuse me for asking, but... Are 
you really sure this is enough?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To think that my birthday celebration 
consists solely of staying by your side as 
much as possible and addressing you as "My 
Lord"...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-sa... Well, she shares the same 
room and class with My Lord. It feels like 
things aren't all that different from 
usual, though.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, splendid! Just hearing thee 
address me as "milord" truly elevates the 
Sengoku atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There is cola prepared in the room. 
It is a finest imported item. I trust it 
will be to your satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~, as expected of my friend! You truly 
know how to hit the spot with me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we share a cup of cola? 
Tonight, I'd like to take it easy and chat 
with you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, don't give me that "early to 
bed, early to rise" talk. I want to get to 
know you better. It's an order from your 
lord, after all. Keep me company, won't 
you, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Of course, I shall 
accompany you. ...My Lord.
